acp.connecting: Shown while the CLI agent session is being established
acp.send: Sends the composed message to the CLI agent
acp.agentModel: Picker for the model the CLI agent uses

sessionStatus.connecting: Lowercase status inside the session pill
sessionStatus.authRequired: Lowercase status inside the session pill: the agent needs a sign-in
sessionStatus.ready: Lowercase status inside the session pill: idle and able to take a message
sessionStatus.running: Lowercase status inside the session pill: answering now
sessionStatus.cancelling: Lowercase status inside the session pill: a stop is in flight
sessionStatus.cancelled: Lowercase status inside the session pill: the turn was stopped
sessionStatus.disconnected: Lowercase status inside the session pill: the process ended
sessionStatus.failed: Lowercase status inside the session pill: the session errored

roster.comingSoon: Hint on an agent that Oleafly does not support yet

bridgeSource.notInstalled: The ACP bridge for this agent is not installed
bridgeSource.managed: Oleafly installed and updates this agent's bridge
bridgeSource.onPath: The bridge was found on the system PATH rather than installed by Oleafly

acp.agentReported: Labels the CLI agent's own raw diagnostic output, which is interpolated verbatim
acp.agentToolFallback: Stands in for a CLI agent tool that reported no name
acp.imageAttachmentName: Name shown on an image chip when the image itself carries no filename
acp.agentImage: Stands in for an image the CLI agent returned; the square brackets mark it as a placeholder, not agent prose

approval.alwaysAllow: Allows this tool for the rest of the session without asking again
approval.alwaysInProject: Allows this tool in this project from now on
approval.toolLabel: Field label naming which tool is being called
approval.commandLabel: Field label above the shell command the assistant wants to run
approval.arguments: Field label above the arguments sent to an external MCP tool
approval.line: Line number badge next to a file, not a text line of prose
approval.firstChange: Marks the first changed line in a diff; L is the abbreviation for line

where.inSettings: Names where the reader can switch AI provider, read inside the surrounding hint sentence.
where.modelMenu: Names where the reader can switch AI provider, read inside the surrounding hint sentence.

exploration.explored: Collapsed summary of read-only tool calls when nothing is counted
exploration.files_one: Counts one file the assistant read, phrased as an article plus noun
exploration.searches_one: Counts one project search the assistant ran
exploration.lists_one: Counts one directory listing the assistant ran

fileChanges.changed: Heading above files edited but not yet committed

pill.plan: Uppercase badge on the run status pill meaning a plan is in progress
pill.step: Uppercase badge showing progress through plan steps
pill.review: Uppercase badge meaning file changes are waiting to be reviewed

plan.headingPlan: Heading of the panel listing the assistant's planned steps
plan.headingChanges: Heading of the panel listing changed files when there is no plan
plan.revise: Sends the plan back for changes instead of approving it
plan.statusApproved: The plan has been approved, not an approved file change

reasoning.label: Header of a collapsed block of model reasoning with no timing

runSummary.plan: Prefix of the run summary line meaning the run followed a plan

chat.steered: Badge on a message that was injected into a run already in progress

subagent.finished: A delegated agent finished its task
subagent.failed: A delegated agent ended with an error
subagent.stopped: A delegated agent was interrupted before finishing
subagent.openTask: Opens the delegated agent's full transcript

status.completed: Screen reader wording for a finished checklist item
status.inProgress: Screen reader wording for the checklist item being worked on
status.pending: Screen reader wording for a checklist item not started
status.cancelled: Screen reader wording for an abandoned checklist item

groups.skills: Heading above skill entries in the slash command menu

archive.label: Slash command that files the current chat away

goal.label: Slash command that sets a standing objective for the assistant

model.label: Slash command that opens the model picker

files.label: Attach menu entry that picks files from disk

composer.plan: Label on the composer toggle that turns Plan mode on and off
composer.personaNone: Picks no persona, leaving the default instructions in place
composer.persona: Label on the persona button when no persona is selected
composer.prompts: Label of the menu of ready-made prompts
composer.checkAgain: Re-runs the compatibility probe for the selected model

goal.label: Field label for the standing objective the assistant works toward

history.staleBadge: Badge on a chat started from an older version of the project
history.deleteFallbackTitle: Stands in for the chat title when the chat has no title
history.untitled: Default name of a chat with no title yet

home.headingAccent: Trailing fragment of the home heading that is painted in the accent gradient; it must appear verbatim at the end of the heading
home.recentStaleBadge: Screen reader label on the dot marking a chat from an older project version

trust.verified: Badge: the assistant has been tested on this model
trust.untested: Badge: the assistant has not been tested on this model yet
trust.blocked: Badge: the assistant cannot run on this model

runtime.builtIn: Name of the in-app assistant runtime, the alternative to a CLI agent
runtime.cli: Name of the runtime that drives an external command line coding agent

shorten.label: Prompt that makes the selected text more concise

expand.label: Prompt that adds detail to a section, not expanding a tree node

keywords.label: Prompt that extracts index keywords from the paper

myLibrary.label: Prompt that searches the user's own imported references

status.active: Short chip status: the delegated agent is running
status.awaiting: Short chip status: the delegated agent is waiting for a permission answer
status.updated: Short chip status: the delegated agent reported new activity
status.interrupted: Short chip status: the delegated agent was stopped
status.completed: Short chip status: the delegated agent finished
status.failed: Short chip status: the delegated agent errored

subagents.workingDetail: Fallback detail line when a delegated agent has reported nothing yet

toolCard.approved: Badge on a tool call the user allowed
toolCard.rejected: Badge on a tool call the user declined
toolCard.openFile: Opens the file the tool produced in the editor
toolCard.openSource: Opens the cited paper or web page the tool found
toolCard.inspectSource: Previews a linked research file without opening the project

toolPicture.figureTab: Tab showing the rendered picture, the alternative to the TikZ source tab
toolPicture.tikzTab: Tab showing the TikZ source code of the figure
toolPicture.saving: Transient label while the figure is being written to the project

approval.never: This tool never asks for approval
approval.everyTime: This tool asks for approval on every call

tools.groupHeading: Accessible name for a tool group, joining the group label with the MCP server name

groups.files: Group of tools that read and write project files
groups.buildAndPdf: Group of tools that compile the project and inspect the PDF
groups.research: Group of tools that search papers and citations
groups.figures: Group of tools that draw and insert figures
groups.planAndMemory: Group of tools for the checklist and saved notes
groups.skills: Group of tools that load skill instructions
groups.agents: Group of tools that start and manage helper agents
groups.system: Group of tools that run commands and change app settings

tools.managerHeading: Heading of the panel that turns individual agent tools on and off
tools.managerTooltip: Tooltip on the wrench button that opens the tool manager

table.asksFirst: Column header saying when a tool needs approval

turn.thinking: Status shown on the first model step of a run
turn.continuing: Status shown on later model steps of the same run
turn.reasoning: Status shown while the model streams its reasoning

usage.steps: Number of model steps in a run, not plan steps
usage.input: Input tokens sent to the model
usage.output: Output tokens returned by the model
usage.runs: Number of assistant runs in this chat
usage.lastRun: Heading above the most recent run's numbers
usage.thisChat: Heading above the running totals for the whole chat
